# Map libraries

Locally hosted npm distributions:

- `maplibre-gl` 5.6.1: maplibre-gl.js and maplibre-gl.css; license in LICENSE.txt.
- `@maplibre/maplibre-gl-leaflet` 0.1.4: leaflet-maplibre-gl.js; license in LICENSE.

OpenFreeMap supplies Liberty (Streets), Positron (Minimal), and Dark (Night) styles. Provider attribution stays visible on the map. Standard OpenStreetMap raster tiles provide a fallback when WebGL or vector styles fail. No API key is required by OpenFreeMap.

Source: https://openfreemap.org/quick_start/
